newsitem.title: USA: Kluge gets 7.3 pct stake in PHP Healthcare.
newsitem.headline: Kluge gets 7.3 pct stake in PHP Healthcare.

text.p: PHP Healthcare Corp said Tuesday that John Kluge, chairman of Metromedia International Group Inc acquired about 800,000 PHP common shares, or or about 7.3 percent, in a series of transactions both private and in the open market.
PHP Healthcare said it sold 200,000 shares to Kluge at $13 per share in a private transaction, subject to registration rights.
Charles Robbins, retired chairman and founder of the company, also sold 300,000 shares to Kluge and used part of the proceeds to repay outstanding obligations to PHP.
Charles P. Reilly, chairman of the PHP board said he welcomes Kluge to "the family of PHP investors" and looks "forward to working with him to enhance shareholder value."
PHP was trading up 1/2 at 17-5/8 Tuesday afternoon.

PHP Healthcare is a full service, integrated care organization that has developed more than 80 healthcare delivery systems in 29 states for public agencies, corporations, HMOs and other third party payers.

Jack Mazur, PHP president and chief executive officer, said that Kluge's stake in the company was for investment purposes only and he had no plans to be actively involved in management of the company.

"Its not contemplated now that he will be offered a board seat, or become an officer," said Mazur. "Mr. Kluge has plenty of investments, but he likes the idea of the health industry and he likes this company's position in it."
Mazur added that Kluge became interested in PHP through previous business dealings and a personal friendhsip with Charles Reilly, its chairman.
